parsed.notes:
Only 'Das bringst Du mit' supplies candidate skill requirements; technologies appearing solely under responsibilities are excluded.
AI assistants and agentic workflows are required because the same item explicitly asks for experience using them, in addition to interest.
Agentic workflows are provisionally mapped to agents; the taxonomy has no exact agentic-workflows entry, so this mapping is flagged for review.
The alternatives 'Softwareentwicklung oder Testautomatisierung' and the example technologies are each labeled as required, without choosing one alternative.
Generic programming and scripting, .NET, and PowerShell have no matching taxonomy entries and are listed as unmapped.
'Verteilte Softwarelösungen' is read literally as distributed systems; on-premise describes the deployment environment rather than a separately named skill.
No usable seniority signal is present: 'einschlägiger Berufserfahrung' gives neither years nor proven experience, and 'langjährige Erfahrung in der Jobsuche' describes the provider rather than the candidate.
